mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stocks WHERE deleted = 0

WITH active_stocks AS ( SELECT id, stocks_shortname FROM torn_stocks WHERE deleted = 0 ) SELECT s.id AS stocksId, s.stocks_shortname AS stocksShortname, c.first_minute AS firstMinute, c.last_minute AS lastMinute, COALESCE(c.minute_count, 0) AS minuteCount, CAST( CASE WHEN c.minute_count IS NULL OR c.minute_count = 0 THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (#{endExclusive} - #{startInclusive})) / 60 ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.first_minute - #{startInclusive})) / 60 END AS bigint) AS leadingGapMinutes, COALESCE(c.internal_gap_segment_count, 0) AS internalGapSegmentCount, COALESCE(c.internal_max_gap_minutes, 0) AS internalMaxGapMinutes, CAST( CASE WHEN c.minute_count IS NULL OR c.minute_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (#{endExclusive} - (c.last_minute + INTERVAL '1 minute'))) / 60 END AS bigint) AS trailingGapMinutes, CAST( CASE WHEN c.minute_count IS NULL OR c.minute_count = 0 THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (#{endExclusive} - #{startInclusive})) / 60 ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.first_minute - #{startInclusive})) / 60 + COALESCE(c.internal_total_gap_minutes, 0) + EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (#{endExclusive} - (c.last_minute + INTERVAL '1 minute'))) / 60 END AS bigint) AS totalMissingMinutes, 0 AS duplicateGroupCount, 0 AS duplicateRedundantRowCount FROM active_stocks s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(raw.minute_time) AS first_minute, MAX(raw.minute_time) AS last_minute, COUNT(*) AS minute_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE raw.newer_minute IS NOT NULL AND raw.newer_minute - raw.minute_time > interval '1 minute' ) AS internal_gap_segment_count, COALESCE(MAX( CASE WHEN raw.newer_minute IS NOT NULL AND raw.newer_minute - raw.minute_time > interval '1 minute' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (raw.newer_minute - raw.minute_time)) / 60 - 1 END ), 0) AS internal_max_gap_minutes, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN raw.newer_minute IS NOT NULL AND raw.newer_minute - raw.minute_time > interval '1 minute' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (raw.newer_minute - raw.minute_time)) / 60 - 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS internal_total_gap_minutes FROM ( SELECT date_trunc('minute', h.reg_date_time) AS minute_time, LAG(date_trunc('minute', h.reg_date_time)) OVER ( ORDER BY h.reg_date_time DESC ) AS newer_minute FROM torn_stocks_history h WHERE h.stocks_id = s.id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND h.reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} ) raw ) c ON true ORDER BY s.id

SELECT data_source AS source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY data_source ORDER BY data_source

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} AND current_price IS NOT NULL AND current_price > 0 AND total_shares IS NOT NULL AND total_shares > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} AND (current_price IS NULL OR current_price <= 0 OR total_shares IS NULL OR total_shares <= 0)

SELECT effective_month AS effectiveMonth, state_status AS stateStatus, manual_override AS manualOverride, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stock_monthly_state WHERE deleted = 0 AND effective_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startInclusive})::date AND effective_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endExclusive} - INTERVAL '1 microsecond')::date GROUP BY effective_month, state_status, manual_override ORDER BY effective_month, state_status, manual_override

SELECT COALESCE(metric_snapshot->>'incompleteReason', 'UNKNOWN') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stock_monthly_state WHERE deleted = 0 AND effective_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startInclusive})::date AND effective_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endExclusive} - INTERVAL '1 microsecond')::date AND state_status = 'DRAFT' GROUP BY metric_snapshot->>'incompleteReason' ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT round_status AS roundStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE deleted = 0 AND round_time >= #{startInclusive} AND round_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY round_status ORDER BY round_status

SELECT setting_key AS settingKey, setting_value AS settingValue FROM sys_setting WHERE deleted = 0 AND setting_key IN ( 'VIP_STOCK_ALERT_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_NEW_ENTRY_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_FORMAL_NOTICE_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_DAILY_SUMMARY_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_RULE_MODE' ) ORDER BY setting_key

SELECT ms.stocks_id AS stocksId, ms.stocks_shortname AS stocksShortname, ms.effective_month AS effectiveMonth, ms.state_status AS stateStatus, ms.personality_rule_version AS personalityRuleVersion, ms.risk_rule_version AS riskRuleVersion, (ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'rawUsableBarCoverage')::float8 AS rawUsableBarCoverage, (ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'rawMaxMissingBucketGap')::bigint AS rawMaxMissingBucketGap, (ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'usableBarCoverage')::float8 AS adjustedUsableBarCoverage, (ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'maxMissingBucketGap')::bigint AS adjustedMaxMissingBucketGap, (ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'excludedBucketCount')::bigint AS excludedBucketCount, (ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'excludedMinutes')::bigint AS excludedMinutes, ms.metric_snapshot -> 'appliedExclusionIds'::text AS appliedExclusionIdsJson, ms.metric_snapshot ->> 'incompleteReason' AS incompleteReason FROM torn_stock_monthly_state ms WHERE ms.deleted = 0 AND ms.effective_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startInclusive})::date AND ms.effective_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endExclusive} - INTERVAL '1 microsecond')::date ORDER BY ms.effective_month ASC, ms.stocks_id ASC
